verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. The release-lane audit now uses an explicit per-workflow REQUIRED_GUARDS mapping, requires every mapped guard to exist and actually reference its workflow, and fails closed unless that guard is invoked by a non-selector-gated workflow. The discovery sweep likewise rejects guards with no runners and enforces per-entry non-vacuity. The focused ReleaseLaneSafeTests pass, and the mapped guards are invoked from docs-quality.yml, which is outside the selector-gated consumer set. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue was found in the diff.
